038package dev.visdb.seesaw.table;
039
040/**
041 * The SsCellEditing interface specifies the methods the SSTableModel will use
042to determine whether or not a given cell can be edited or if a user-specified
043value for a cell is valid or invalid.
044 */
045public interface SsCellEditing {
046  /**
047   * This function is called when ever a update to a cell is done but before the
048   * value is updated in the database.<BR>
049   * If the function returns false the update is cancelled, if it returns true the
050   * value will be updated in the database.<BR>
051   *
052   * @param row      the row in which update is taking place.
053   * @param column   the column at which update is taking place.
054   * @param oldValue the present value in the cell being edited.
055   * @param newValue the new value entered in the cell being edited.
056   *
057   * @return returns true if update should be made else false.
058   */
059  default boolean cellUpdateRequested(int row, int column, Object oldValue, Object newValue) {
060    return true;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Returns true if the cell at row _row and at column _column is editable else
065   * false.
066   * <p>
067SSTableModel first looks in to uneditable columns, if the column is not in
068the uneditable columns list then this function is called (If SsCellEditing is
069implemented).
070   *
071   * @param row    the row to which the cell belongs.
072   * @param column the column to which the cell belongs.
073   *
074   * @return returns true is the cell is editable else false.
075   */
076  default boolean isCellEditable(int row, int column) {
077    return true;
078  }
079
080} // end public interface SsCellEditing {
